description: A save written inside an interior (PL.core-interior-save-state; rulings U122(4), U122(2), U124(1), U49(3); Unreal run 15 P6 m3). currentState.interiorState is the building the player is inside, or null outside: {buildingId, buildingName, buildingType, layoutSeed}. layoutSeed is null for a stated interior (BuildingIR.interior; the IR lays it out, the only kind core lays out) and a finite integer only for a seeded one (a host generator's); a load reads an absent or non-integer layoutSeed as null. While interiorState is not null, player.position and player.rotation are in the interior's own frame (docs/props-and-interiors.md section 1a), never an engine's off-village bay; the save's positionFrame names the world frame of everything else. A load places the player (interiorLoadOf) and never refuses: no load-refusal code is added (U124(1)). Runner: src/interior-save-corpus.ts (ops read, load, round_trip; controls refused). Numbers compare within tolerance; everything else exactly, object key sets included. Regenerate with npm run interior-save-corpus; npm run interior-save-corpus:check fails on any difference.
sources: Unreal run 15 (requests/to-manager/2026-11-17-unreal-run15) P6 m3: a save written inside an interior needs interiorState.layoutSeed and a stated frame for player.position. Unreal 22f657b writes interiorState without layoutSeed ("Interiors are not generated from a seed here (the IR states the layout)", InsimulVillageProps.cpp WriteInteriorIntoSave) and draws each interior in a bay from kInteriorBayX = -500000 cm.

The interior frame: docs/props-and-interiors.md section 1a (U95(4)) and conformance/props/doors.json's interior-frame case, whose building (Brightwater's Denham's Tavern as pipelines 5328ed2 exports it) these cases reuse.
Babylon origin/main bfcdeb2 typed SavedInteriorState.layoutSeed as a number and never wrote an interior (BabylonGame getInteriorState returns null): the seeded shape here is synthetic.
Every expected is core's answer; every control is a case's answer with one thing changed; src/conformance/__tests__/interior-save-corpus.test.ts pins the rules independently.

contract.shape: interiorState: null (outside) | {buildingId: non-empty string, buildingName: string, buildingType: string, layoutSeed: null | integer}; a record without a non-empty string buildingId reads as null; a non-string name or type reads as ''
contract.layoutSeedRule: null (the sentinel, STATED_LAYOUT_SEED): a stated interior, laid out by BuildingIR.interior. A finite integer, 0 included: a seeded interior, laid out by a host generator from it. A load reads an absent or non-integer layoutSeed as null
contract.positionFrameRule: interiorState not null: player.position and player.rotation are in the interior's own frame (metres; origin at its minimum corner; x across 0..width, z from the front wall z = 0 to depth, y up; unturned and unmoved by the building). An engine drawing the frame's origin at its own point O writes p - O in IR axes and loads by drawing at O + p. interiorState null: they are in the world frame the positionFrame slot names. The villagers' positions are always the world frame's
contract.writerRule: gameState.interiorState absent: the stored currentState.interiorState is carried; null: null is written; else readInteriorState of it is written (a stated interior with layoutSeed null; an unreadable one as null)
contract.readerRule: currentState.interiorState read by readInteriorState: the game state carries it when it names a building, and has no interiorState outside
contract.loadRule: interiorLoadOf: interiorState null: outside, saved position and rotation (rotation {0,0,0} when absent), frame world. Building not in the world: outside, position and rotation null, note unknown_building. Seeded, or the building states no interior: outside at doorView(b).outside (rotation {0, yaw, 0}), notes seeded_interior and no_interior. Stated and the position a point of the frame: inside interior:<id>, saved position and rotation. Stated otherwise: inside, at doorStep enter's arrive (the first entrance) with rotation {0,0,0} (facing +z, in), or position and rotation null when the interior lists no entrance; note position_outside_interior
contract.framePointRule: a point of the interior frame: x, y, z finite; x in [-t, width + t], z in [-t, depth + t], y in [-t, height + t]; t = positionToleranceM; height as stated, else floors (at least 1) times defaultFloorHeightM; width and depth must be finite and positive, else no point is one
contract.loadNotesAreNotRefusals: a note says why the player is not where the save put them; the load is accepted. The load-refusal codes are unchanged (U124(1)): loadRefusalCodes

replay.input: read: input.interiorState. load: input.interiorState, input.player.position and .rotation, input.buildings (the door model's building input plus the interior's width, depth, height and floors). round_trip: a runtime save over input.fresh saves input.gameState with writeOptions; a second over input.fresh loads what was written with readOptions; then load over the loaded game state
replay.compare: numbers within tolerance, everything else exactly, object key sets included (compareVillageState)
replay.controls: each control is a case's answer with one thing changed. A runner must refuse every one: run the named case and compare its answer with the control's

cases.name: read: a stated interior carries layoutSeed null
read: a stated interior with no layoutSeed (Unreal's writer at 22f657b) reads as stated, layoutSeed null
read: a seeded interior keeps its seed
read: layoutSeed 0 is a seed, not the sentinel
read: a layoutSeed of 2.5 (not an integer) reads as null, stated
read: a string layoutSeed reads as null, stated
read: outside, interiorState null
read: a record with no buildingId is not an interior (null)
read: a missing name and type read as ''
load: inside a stated interior, a point of its frame is kept (interior frame)
load: inside a stated interior, upstairs (floor 1, y 3.9 of 6 m) is kept
load: inside a stated interior, standing in the entrance (z −0.3, within the 0.5 m tolerance) is kept
load: a stated interior carrying an engine-frame position (Unreal's 5 km bay) is not kept: the player arrives at the entrance, facing in
cases.note: The control "stated-interior-engine-frame-position-kept" claims the bay point is kept; a runner must refuse it.

cases.name: load: a stated interior carrying a world-frame position (by the building) is not kept: the entrance
load: a stated interior carrying a position above its height (y 7 of 6 m) is not kept
load: a stated interior with no entrance and a position not in its frame: inside, no stated point (the host places the player)
load: an interior with no stated height is floors × 3 m high: y 6.4 of 6 m is kept (within 0.5 m)
load: an interior with no stated height is floors × 3 m high: y 6.6 is not kept
load: a locked door does not keep a load out (a load is not a key check): the entrance
load: a seeded interior is not re-entered: outside, at the door, facing out
load: a building whose world states no interior: outside, at its door
load: a building not in this world: outside, no stated point
load: outside (interiorState null): the saved world-frame position is kept
round trip: saved inside a stated interior, loaded inside it at the same interior-frame point
round trip: a game reporting Unreal's shape (no layoutSeed) is written with layoutSeed null and loads inside
round trip: a seeded interior keeps its seed through the save; the load puts the player outside at the door
round trip: outside, interiorState null is written null and loads outside at the saved world point
round trip: a game reporting no interiorState carries the stored one (absent is not null)
cases.note: The fresh document already says the player is inside the tavern; a game state without the key leaves it as stored.

cases.name: round trip: an engine-frame position saved inside is written as given; the load does not keep it (the entrance)

controls.change: the bay point is kept as the player's interior-frame position, with no note

controls.name: seed-zero-read-as-stated
